articles.title: Titans use special teams plays and defense to rally past Colts 26-20 for 1st win of the season
articles.dek: The Tennessee Titans used a 58-yard punt return to set up their first touchdown, returned a blocked punt for another score and got a 49-yard field goal from Joey Slye with 2:03 to play to get their first win of the season, 26-20 at Indianapolis.

articles.title: Bryce Young throws for 2 TDs and leads Panthers to 25-14 win over injury-riddled Eagles
articles.dek: Bryce Young threw for 281 yards and two touchdowns to Tommy Tremble, and Chuba Hubbard ran for 120 yards and a score to lead the Carolina Panthers past the injury-riddled Philadelphia Eagles 25-14.

articles.title: Driver in deadly Kansas soccer field crash released while investigation continues
articles.dek: Police say a woman who drove a pickup truck onto a soccer field during a weekend youth game in Kansas, killing two people and injuring several others, has been released as the investigation continues.

articles.title: Rams kicker Blake Grupe injures knee vs. Cardinals in first game with new team
articles.dek: Los Angeles Rams kicker Blake Grupe injured his right knee in his first game with his new team Sunday while making a tackle on special teams in the 18-16 loss to the Arizona Cardinals.

articles.title: Saints make Giants pay for mistakes as late rally led by J.J. McCarthy falls short
articles.dek: J.J. McCarthy replaced Jameis Winston with the Giants trailing 34-10 in the fourth and scored 17 unanswered points but couldn't complete the comeback.

articles.title: Flight from Tel Aviv to Vienna makes emergency landing in Bulgaria after bomb threat
articles.dek: Bulgaria state television reports that a flight from Tel Aviv made an emergency landing in Sofia after a bomb threat.

articles.title: Deshaun Watson leads drive for winning field goal and Browns rally for 13-10 victory over Ravens
articles.dek: Deshaun Watson connected with Jerry Jeudy for 33 yards to set up Andre Szmyt's 37-yard field goal on the final snap, and the Cleveland Browns rallied past the Baltimore Ravens 13-10.

articles.title: The AI industry’s gigantic debts are making investors nervous
articles.dek: Who will be left to pick up the bill in the event of a crash?
